title: Selection, split and analysis freeze
freeze_timestamp_rule: spec + build + manifest committed BEFORE any Q5 transfer-test code runs

selection_boundary.source: Q1 registry (99 entries = 1 reference + 98 mutants from Zenodo rna_map_dg.csv / mttr6_data_full.json)
inclusion_criteria: variant is in mttr6 TTR mutant set
has published RNA-MaP rna_map_dg in Zenodo
maintains wild-type-like binding mode (receptor + GAAA tetraloop architecture preserved)
exclusion_criteria: reference construct excluded from mutant set
no extrapolation to arbitrary TLR families
selection_boundary.q2_attrition_interaction: All 98 variants retained in selection. Q2 attrition (84 fitted + 11 right-censored + 2 closing-pair-abnormal + 1 alternate-structure) affects analysis weighting NOT selection. Censored enter likelihood not deleted.

mutation_edit_graph.definition: Vertices = 98 variants. Edge if aligned_seq Hamming distance == 1 (single-nucleotide difference).
mutation_edit_graph.equivalence_rule: same bp_muts tuple (e.g. all variants with bp_muts=[CG1GC] are base-pair-equivalent)
mutation_edit_graph.leakage_prohibition: Adjacent (Hamming-1) or equivalent (same bp_muts) variants must NOT be split across train/test. Connected components assigned to folds atomically.

outer_groups.split_method: mutation-graph-aware connected-component grouping; K=5 folds; components assigned greedily by size to balance folds; variant-level splitting (all 16 titration rows of a variant in same fold)
outer_groups.no_leakage_rule: Adjacent or equivalent variants in same fold

baseline.B1_intercept_mean_baseline: predict training-set mean rna_map_dg for all held-out (constant)
baseline.B2_published_univariate_relationship: linear regression rna_map_dg ~ mg_1_2 on training; predict held-out
baseline.B3_sequence_mutation_baseline: linear regression rna_map_dg ~ (bp_muts one-hot + mutation_count) on training; predict held-out
baseline.B4_locked_partial_id_calibration: rna_map_dg ~ old_dg (tecto ΔG) linear calibration on training; predict held-out

primary_metric.name: held_out_negative_log_predictive_density
primary_metric.description: Average -log N(mu_i, sigma_i^2) over held-out variants and 5 folds. Lower is better.

secondary_metrics.S1_reference_dg_ranking_spearman: Spearman corr predicted vs true rna_map_dg on held-out

minimum_meaningful_effect.description: held-out RMSE < 1.0 kcal/mol to beat paper precision target; improvements < 0.5 not meaningful

power_rule.rule: declare outperformance if mean fold-level RMSE improvement > 0.3 kcal/mol AND 95% CI of paired difference excludes 0

negative_controls.NC1_closing_pair_only: closing-pair-only mutants should predict near-wild-type ΔG
negative_controls.NC2_label_permutation: permute rna_map_dg labels; expect chance-level held-out score
negative_controls.NC3_negative_nucleotide: random draw from training marginal = B1 baseline

calibration_rule.method: isotonic regression on training (predicted,true); frozen; applies to B4 only; B1/B2/B3 use native predictions

interval_rule.method: Gaussian PI: pred +/- z*sigma; z=1.0 (68%) or 1.96 (95%); sigma from training residuals; min_width_68=0.5, max_width_68=5.0 kcal/mol

adjudication_logic.QMAP_TRANSFER_SUPPORTED: B4 achieves: (a) held-out RMSE < 1.0 AND (b) preregistered gain over B1 > 0.3 with 95% CI excluding 0 AND (c) 68% coverage in [0.55,0.80] AND (d) label-permutation p<0.05
adjudication_logic.QMAP_TRANSFER_NOT_SUPPORTED: B4 fails one or more of (a)-(d); negative/borderline evidence
adjudication_logic.QMAP_INCONCLUSIVE: insufficient power to distinguish B4 from B1; uncertainty/power boundary
adjudication_logic.QMAP_NOT_ADMITTED: Q0-Q3 gates not all PASS; provenance insufficient
